answer:
I changed the Household expenses page so it only shows Food and Housing. The total, the percentage bar, the category list and the "Latest" list now leave out Bills and Health. The "Add an expense" dropdown offers only those two categories.

Your note's table is unchanged, so the Electricity and Dentist rows are still there. The page just hides them. The previous version of the page is kept if you want it back.

I also fixed a bug in the page. It didn't recognise your "Amt" column as the amount, so it would have shown "Add a table with an Amount column" instead of your data. I haven't opened the page to check how it looks.
